scripts.deploy: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); fs.rmSync('docs', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.mkdirSync('docs/e-cafe', {recursive: true}); function copyDir(src, dest) { const files = fs.readdirSync(src); files.forEach(file => { const srcPath = path.join(src, file); const destPath = path.join(dest, file); if (fs.statSync(srcPath).isDirectory()) { fs.mkdirSync(destPath, {recursive: true}); copyDir(srcPath, destPath); } else { fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath); } }); } copyDir('out', 'docs/e-cafe');"
